Generates a comprehensive report to drive system improvement lifecycle and
focus.

Runs on a cadence and can optionally trigger remediation and adaptive
scheduler-cadence tuning.

  Generate improvement report
  zqk system improvement-report
  Generate JSON report without remediation triggers
  zqk system improvement-report --format json --trigger-remediation=false

Usage:
  zqk system improvement-report [flags]

Flags:
      --apply-adaptive-cadence   Apply adaptive cadence recommendation to SCH-improvement-report with change cooldown (default true)
      --emit-events              Emit coordinator events for report completion (for dashboards)
      --persist-snapshot-audit   Persist compact improvement snapshot to audit_event for queryable history (default true)
      --report-file string       Write report to this path (default: .zqk/logs/reports/improvement-report-<timestamp>.{txt,json})
      --trigger-remediation      After writing the report, enqueue scheduler jobs to address work items (default true)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
